title: Snow Removal Checklist
subtitle: Residential Snow Removal: documents findings, limits, and disposition.
description: Snow Removal Checklist covers drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone. The snow service coordinator records Residential Snow Removal criteria, findings, restrictions, and follow-up. Snow Removal Checklist keeps Residential Snow Removal exceptions visible until the snow service coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Snow Removal Checklist at residence access, drive, walkway, steps, curb, and designated snow-storage area. Document drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone identity before Residential Snow Removal begins. Compare drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone findings with stated Residential Snow Removal criteria; route unresolved Residential Snow Removal issues to winter operations reviewer. For Snow Removal Checklist, confirm requirements for Residential Snow Removal. Ask winter operations reviewer to review Residential Snow Removal conditions beyond the snow service coordinator's role.

sections.title: Inspection scope and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Residential Snow Removal, identify responsible parties, residence access, drive, walkway, steps, curb, and designated snow-storage area, and the linked drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone source.

fields.label: Service trigger, depth, timing, and priority area
Surface type, marker, obstacle, drainage, and product restriction

sections.title: Checklist findings and inspection checks
sections.guidance: Capture Residential Snow Removal facts for drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone; include result, limit, source, and next control.

columns.label: Pass, issue, N/A, or not inspected

blocks.label: Residential Snow Removal inspection checks
items: Snow depth, ice condition, and precipitation stage
Vehicle, pedestrian, emergency, and delivery access
Surface edge, marker, drain, hydrant, and hidden-obstacle location
Plowed or shoveled width and snow placement
Deicer or abrasive type, amount, and restricted area
Refreeze, drifting, residual ice, and return trigger

sections.title: Deficiencies, inspection decision, and follow-up
sections.guidance: List each unresolved Residential Snow Removal finding with its restriction, correction owner, and reinspection trigger. Snow Service Coordinator records reviewer disposition.

blocks.label: Deficiencies, restrictions, and retained evidence
items: Visibility, lightning, extreme condition, or unsafe equipment operation
Blocked drain, hydrant, road, or neighboring property
Refreeze or continuing storm defeats completed condition
blocks.guidance: Pause Residential Snow Removal when safe operation, access, snow placement, drainage, hidden obstacle, or residual ice remains uncontrolled. Retain the available Residential Snow Removal proof and route unresolved drive, walk, step, entrance, snow storage area, drainage point, and treatment zone scope to snow service coordinator.
